import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
for name in ['packing','scaling']:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',f'sources/{name}.pdf','-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
 w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),f'sources/{name}.txt'],input=r.stdout,capture_output=True,text=True);assert w.returncode==0
 print('FILE',name,'chars',len(r.stdout));print(r.stdout[:25500] if name=='packing' else r.stdout)
